package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
)

const StudentLearningWorkspaceSchema = "student-learning-workspace.v1"

// StudentLearningWorkspace is the narrow, read-only projection used by Teacher
// for legacy generic workspace navigation. Authoritative progression decisions
// come from NextActionResolver, never consumer selection of these items. It deliberately contains no Student identity,
// planning request, evidence, Course content, or command/receipt identifiers.
type StudentLearningWorkspace struct {
	Schema         string                                `json:"schema"`
	ContextVersion int64                                 `json:"context_version"`
	SelectedPath   *StudentLearningWorkspaceSelectedPath `json:"selected_path,omitempty"`
}

// StudentLearningWorkspaceSelectedPath is emitted only for the exact selected
// ACTIVE path observed with its Student-owned context.
type StudentLearningWorkspaceSelectedPath struct {
	LearningPathID string                         `json:"learning_path_id"`
	CourseID       string                         `json:"course_id"`
	Status         LearningPathStatus             `json:"status"`
	PathVersion    int64                          `json:"path_version"`
	Items          []StudentLearningWorkspaceItem `json:"items"`
}

// StudentLearningWorkspaceItem omits targets and planner rationale. Position
// plus the current item status lets a consumer deterministically choose the
// first IN_PROGRESS item, otherwise the first READY item for generic navigation
// only. This selection is not an authoritative Next Best Action. Without mutating
// Student state.
type StudentLearningWorkspaceItem struct {
	ReferenceType string                 `json:"reference_type"`
	ReferenceID   string                 `json:"reference_id"`
	Position      int                    `json:"position"`
	Status        LearningPathItemStatus `json:"status"`
}

// StudentLearningWorkspaceSource is repository-only input. StudentID never
// crosses the HTTP boundary; it is used to bind the context and path before
// projection.
type StudentLearningWorkspaceSource struct {
	StudentID    string
	Context      StudentLearningContext
	SelectedPath *StudentLearningPath
}

func BuildStudentLearningWorkspace(input StudentLearningWorkspaceSource) (StudentLearningWorkspace, error) {
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	if !validJourneyUUID(input.StudentID) {
		return StudentLearningWorkspace{}, errors.New("invalid learning workspace student")
	}

	contextValue := input.Context
	if contextValue.Version == 0 {
		if contextValue.StudentID != "" || contextValue.SelectedLearningPathID != "" || contextValue.UpdatedAt != nil || input.SelectedPath != nil {
			return StudentLearningWorkspace{}, errors.New("invalid empty learning workspace context")
		}
		return StudentLearningWorkspace{Schema: StudentLearningWorkspaceSchema, ContextVersion: 0}, nil
	}
	contextValue, err := NormalizeStudentLearningContext(contextValue)
	if err != nil || contextValue.StudentID != input.StudentID {
		return StudentLearningWorkspace{}, errors.New("invalid learning workspace context")
	}
	if input.SelectedPath == nil {
		if contextValue.SelectedLearningPathID != "" {
			return StudentLearningWorkspace{}, errors.New("missing selected learning workspace path")
		}
		return StudentLearningWorkspace{Schema: StudentLearningWorkspaceSchema, ContextVersion: contextValue.Version}, nil
	}
	path, err := NormalizeStudentLearningPath(*input.SelectedPath)
	if err != nil || path.StudentID != input.StudentID || path.ID != contextValue.SelectedLearningPathID ||
		path.Status != LearningPathStatusActive || path.Version < 1 {
		return StudentLearningWorkspace{}, errors.New("invalid selected learning workspace path")
	}
	items := make([]StudentLearningWorkspaceItem, len(path.Items))
	for index, item := range path.Items {
		items[index] = StudentLearningWorkspaceItem{
			ReferenceType: item.ReferenceType,
			ReferenceID:   item.ReferenceID,
			Position:      item.Position,
			Status:        item.Status,
		}
	}
	return NormalizeStudentLearningWorkspace(StudentLearningWorkspace{
		Schema:         StudentLearningWorkspaceSchema,
		ContextVersion: contextValue.Version,
		SelectedPath: &StudentLearningWorkspaceSelectedPath{
			LearningPathID: path.ID,
			CourseID:       path.CourseID,
			Status:         path.Status,
			PathVersion:    path.Version,
			Items:          items,
		},
	})
}

func NormalizeStudentLearningWorkspace(input StudentLearningWorkspace) (StudentLearningWorkspace, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	if input.Schema != StudentLearningWorkspaceSchema || input.ContextVersion < 0 {
		return StudentLearningWorkspace{}, errors.New("invalid learning workspace")
	}
	if input.SelectedPath == nil {
		return input, nil
	}
	path := *input.SelectedPath
	path.LearningPathID = strings.TrimSpace(path.LearningPathID)
	path.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(path.CourseID)
	if input.ContextVersion < 1 || !validJourneyUUID(path.LearningPathID) || !validJourneyUUID(path.CourseID) ||
		path.Status != LearningPathStatusActive || path.PathVersion < 1 || len(path.Items) < 1 || len(path.Items) > 500 {
		return StudentLearningWorkspace{}, errors.New("invalid learning workspace path")
	}
	items := make([]StudentLearningWorkspaceItem, len(path.Items))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(path.Items))
	for index, item := range path.Items {
		item.ReferenceType = normalizeOnboardingCode(item.ReferenceType)
		item.ReferenceID = strings.TrimSpace(item.ReferenceID)
		if (item.ReferenceType != "lesson" && item.ReferenceType != "practice") || !validJourneyUUID(item.ReferenceID) ||
			item.Position != index || !validPathItemStatus(item.Status) {
			return StudentLearningWorkspace{}, errors.New("invalid learning workspace item")
		}
		identity := item.ReferenceType + ":" + item.ReferenceID
		if _, exists := seen[identity]; exists {
			return StudentLearningWorkspace{}, errors.New("duplicate learning workspace item")
		}
		seen[identity] = struct{}{}
		items[index] = item
	}
	path.Items = items
	input.SelectedPath = &path
	return input, nil
}
